items.question: How long does clear aligner treatment take?
items.answer: Treatment duration varies depending on the complexity of your case. During your consultation, your dentist will provide a personalized treatment timeline.

items.question: Are clear aligners better than traditional braces?
items.answer: Clear aligners are removable, nearly invisible, and generally more comfortable, making them an excellent option for many patients with mild to moderate alignment issues.

items.question: How many hours should I wear my clear aligners?
items.answer: For the best results, aligners should typically be worn for 20–22 hours each day, removing them only while eating, drinking (except water), and brushing.

items.question: Can I eat while wearing clear aligners?
items.answer: No. Aligners should be removed before eating or drinking anything other than water to prevent damage and staining.

items.question: Are clear aligners painful?
items.answer: Most patients experience only mild pressure or temporary discomfort when switching to a new set of aligners, which is a normal sign that the teeth are moving.

items.question: What is the cost of clear aligners in Pune?

items.question: Who is a good candidate for clear aligners?
items.answer: Clear aligners are suitable for teenagers and adults with mild to moderate spacing, crowding, or bite alignment issues. Your dentist will determine your eligibility after a detailed evaluation.
